caption: The drawing contains a single shoe depicted in a side view, occupying the central left area of the composition. The shoe is ankle-high, with a curved, pointed toe and a flat heel, and includes a visible seam running from the ankle down to the instep area, where it is secured with what appear to be horizontal fasteners or eyelets. The main body of the shoe is shaded with a mix of purple and pink hues, applied in a textured, cross-hatched fashion, while the sole and heel are colored in black. In the upper right section of the drawing, there is an outline of the shoe’s sole in black, presented within a rectangular frame. The background is a plain off-white or beige color, and the shoe is set against an outlined box or panel, creating a separation from the rest of the paper.
title: Woman's Shoe
